item.title: Parish Council puts charter changes on ballot -- but when?
Krewe of Adonis up next on Mardi Gras schedule
item.description: Lily Kay Photography Kolin Leonard and Rachel Smith were crowned King and Queen Adonis L at the 2025 Krewe of Adonis ball. Their successors will be crowned Saturday. Staff report East St. Mary’s Mardi Gras events continue Saturday with the Krewe of Adonis ball and tableau. The ball is scheduled for 7 p.m. at Morgan City Municipal Auditorium.

item.title: CAROLYN WILLIAMS SONS
item.description: Carolyn Williams Sons, 85, a resident of Slidell and former resident of Bayou Vista, died Monday, Jan. 12, 2026. She was preceded in death by her husband, son and four siblings.

item.title: Pet Talk: Making the right choice when picking your cat's food
item.description: Texas A&M photo Fiber content, caloric needs and feline flexibility are considerations when choosing a cat food. A cat’s health begins with diet.

item.title: John K. Flores: Hunter harvests some rare birds
item.description: The Review/John K. Flores Jake Pierron holds the 10th oldest male blue winged teal on record out of the same blind his grandfather in years past. The worn band of Pierron’s old blue winged teal. Pierron’s USGS Certificate Jake Pierron holds the hybrid blue winged teal/cinnamon teal. Jake Pierron and daughter Anna Rose with their retriever Lou-Lou Bell, show off the 10th oldest male blue winged teal on record. Houma resident Jake Pierron comes from a long line of duck hunters.
